title: Wanting to play Basie-style drums in Shaw's band
summary: Leeman has Jo Jones and Basie in mind but Shaw wants something different, and nobody in the east knows the Kansas City band.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: You see, drumnistically, I was forming in my mind the routines that we were playing, but I still had Jo Jones instilled in the back of my mind and the Basie band, and that's the kind of music I like, along with my records of Duke Ellington.
And Shaw's band was an entirely different thing -- he was trying to find a style, and I had gathered a few little

things. I wanted to play in the Basie vein, but it didn't work out with what Artie Shaw had in mind, and I would mention Basie's band in Kansas City, and nobody knew what I was talking about, because they hadn't quite come back east yet.
